blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — The Philippine Military Academy (PMA) formally welcomed 323 freshmen cadets of the Masiklab Lahi Class of 2030 into the Corps of Cadets during recognition rites on Saturday, marking the last time the academy will hold separate ceremonies for the incorporation and recognition of new cadets. PMA Superintendent Lt. Gen. Michael Logico told the new fourth-class cadets, equivalent to first-year college students, that the next batch, Class of 2031, would be fully integrated into the Corps of Cadets upon incorporation, restoring the academy’s traditional practice. “Traditionally, this (recognition rites) was supposed to happen upon incorporation.
